authorization: After the Gate 2 / Gate 4 conflict was reported, the user instructed that it be fixed or recorded in a separate file before execution.

conflict.gate2_rule: Section 35 makes any failed Gate 2 condition terminal.
conflict.gate4_rule: Section 39 requires another seed for specified borderline cases, including a positive effect below the Gate 2 threshold or a confidence interval containing zero.
conflict.resolution_principle: Treat the more specific Gate 4 borderline rule as a predeclared deferral, while preserving every Gate 2 A-F requirement as a final requirement.

authoritative_interpretation.seed0_evaluation: Compute Gate 2, Gate 3 safety, and Gate 3 control before deciding whether a borderline Gate 2 result is terminal.
borderline_if_any: exactly one transfer-direction M1_vs_B4 effect is positive
authoritative_interpretation.seed0_gate2_status: When no seed1-forbidden condition holds and any borderline condition holds, use PENDING_GATE4 even if any seed0 Gate 2 A-F conditions fail. A Gate 2 failure is immediately terminal only when no borderline condition holds.
authoritative_interpretation.seed0_veto_precedence: If raw seed0 Gate 2 passed, a Gate 3 safety or control veto retains its own terminal verdict. If raw seed0 Gate 2 failed and was only a provisional Gate 4 candidate, either veto retracts the deferral, sets Gate 2 to FINAL_FAIL, and emits SIMPLE_ONLINE_COMBINATION_GO_RETRIEVAL_NO_GO in failure-first order; the measured Gate 3 result is preserved only as an eligibility observation.
authoritative_interpretation.additional_seed_training: For every additional seed, retrain Point and Hurdle and repeat source-only B3, B4, and M1 selection. Target outcomes must not influence selection.
authoritative_interpretation.seed_average_unit: Within an exactly matching dataset_id/series_id/origin key set, average each policy's normalized loss across seeds. Do not average predictions, retrieval indices, or selected hyperparameters.
authoritative_interpretation.seed_average_gate2: Recompute all Gate 2 A-F quantities and the stratified series-cluster bootstrap from seed-averaged B3, B4, and M1 policy losses.
authoritative_interpretation.gate3_across_seeds: Additional-seed Gate 3 values are diagnostic-only. Seed0 Gate 3 safety and control remain the eligibility and final predecessor checks.
authoritative_interpretation.terminal_pass_rule: RETRIEVAL_MEMORY_GO requires seed0 Gate 3 safety and control PASS, Gate 4 robustness PASS when invoked, and the applicable final Gate 2 A-F evaluation PASS. When Gate 4 is invoked, the applicable Gate 2 evaluation is the seed-averaged evaluation.
authoritative_interpretation.terminal_fail_rule: If Gate 4 passes its sign/retention rule but seed-averaged Gate 2 A-F fails, emit SIMPLE_ONLINE_COMBINATION_GO_RETRIEVAL_NO_GO. PENDING_GATE4 is never a terminal scientific verdict.

prohibited_shortcuts: Gate 4 may not override a failed final Gate 2 A-F evaluation.
Additional-seed predictions, retrieval indices, or selected hyperparameters may not be averaged.
Mismatched dataset/series/origin key sets may not be silently intersected.
No rule in this resolution may be changed after preregistration freeze.
scope_rationale: Section 39 introduces the three seed1-forbidden conditions with the exhaustive wording '즉 다음이면 seed1 실행 금지'.
Accordingly, no additional unlisted Gate 2 check is treated as a fourth seed1 prohibition.
This deferral does not relax Gate 2 because all six A-F checks are recomputed and required on the seed-averaged losses before a final GO.
